telemetry_aggregation: Repeated successful command output was compacted to commands, exit status, check counts, warning count, and exception events; raw verifier logs were not retained.
temporary_material_deleted: none; no screenshots, recordings, provider output, copied upload, persistent private key, or retained test package was created by this receipt workflow
explicit_retention_exceptions: The timestamp-parser failure and repair are preserved because they changed emitted validation behavior.
The retrospective-binding and typed-stage audit discoveries are preserved because each changed the final contract.
Canonical checkout state is retained only as aggregate counts and commit facts, without file listings or private content.
authority_used: append-only receipt creation and local TEST branch commit only; no deletion, merge, install, promotion, or CANON authority used
